youtube_title: The Stolen Airplane the Car-Theft Law Didn't Cover (1931) 🦝⚖️
caption: McBoyle v. United States (1931): the Supreme Court held a stolen airplane wasn't a 'vehicle' under the motor-vehicle theft law of the time, citing fair warning. Federal law now expressly covers aircraft.
